
=== ROSTER WALK: Magda, Brazen Outlaw (R) ===
  11 two-colour cycles (ABUR dual, Shockland, Fetchland, Horizon land, Painland, Filter land, Battlebond land, Checkland, Pathway, Surveil land, Fastland) are off-identity and ILLEGAL in R -- no pair rows to walk.
  Fetchlands and any-colour painlands are legal here and strictly worse than a basic without shuffle payoffs: walked and skipped.
